title: French Crumble Tart
description: A delicious French dessert featuring a crumble topping over a yogurt and indulgent filling.
instructions: Melt chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
In a separate bowl, mix together yogurt and caramel sauce.
Roll out the crumble topping to a thickness of about 1cm (1/2 inch).
Place the crumble topping over the yogurt mixture in a 20cm (8 inch) tart pan.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Dust with flour and serve warm.
